name: Kingdom Global Arcs and Mutable Storyline

records.label: Overview
notes: These arcs began as canon-grounded pressures at the campaign start. They do not precommit future victories, deaths, promotions, meetings, or chronology. Player and NPC actions may delay, redirect, transform, or prevent later arcs. Every active arc has a real owner and next review. Dormant arcs activate only when their saved prerequisites become true.

Arc settlement law
notes: A monthly world close cannot advance an arc merely because time passed. Each progression needs actor, action, target, means, authority, route, resources, opposition, and a result receipt. If the player changes the prerequisites, canon becomes a reference trajectory rather than a forced script.
